title: Coarsest SIRead granularity: max_pred_locks_per_page 2->0, per_relation -2->0
configuration_cause: Predicate-lock promotion thresholds remain at defaults (max_pred_locks_per_page=2, max_pred_locks_per_relation=-2) while max_pred_locks_per_transaction is already 8192; SIRead locks are promoted to coarser page/relation granularity early, adding per-txn lock bookkeeping on the dominant GetUserTweets path.
mechanism: SERIALIZABLE GetUserTweets dominates terminal capacity (0.88). With max_pred_locks_per_page=2 and max_pred_locks_per_relation=-2, PostgreSQL promotes SIRead locks to page/relation granularity after only 2 page locks, inflating lock bookkeeping per transaction. Setting both to 0 forces the coarsest granularity immediately, minimizing per-txn predicate-lock churn. lock_waiting_backends.max=0 and locks_waiting.max=0 confirm no actual lock contention, so this is bookkeeping cost, not blocking. Prior r005 (2->8, -2->4) was refuted; r006 (2->32, -2->16) untested. The 0-bound is the untested opposite extreme of the same granularity axis.
query_effect: GetUserTweets SIRead locks stay at coarsest page/relation granularity, reducing per-transaction lock bookkeeping on the dominant path.
expected_tps_effect: Small increase in successful_transaction_tps if predicate-lock bookkeeping is a measurable cost; unchanged if lock churn is negligible.
expected_latency_effect: Slight decrease in GetUserTweets p99; p50/p95 largely unchanged.

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Safe low bound 0; forces coarsest page-level SIRead locking. Prior r005 tested 2->8 (refuted), r006 tested 2->32 (untested); 0 is the untested opposite extreme of the same granularity axis.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: page-level predicate-lock granularity cap; 0 forces coarsest page-level SIRead locking

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Safe low bound 0; forces coarsest relation-level SIRead locking. Prior r005 tested -2->4 (refuted), r006 tested -2->16 (untested); 0 is the untested opposite extreme.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: relation-level predicate-lock granularity cap; 0 forces coarsest relation-level SIRead locking

predictions.rationale: Coarsest SIRead granularity reduces total lock count p95 versus incumbent 2343.
Less per-txn lock bookkeeping trims GetUserTweets tail from 1816us.
Freed terminal capacity from reduced bookkeeping raises completed TPS.

alternatives.statement: If predicate-lock bookkeeping is negligible, locks_total.p95 stays flat and TPS is unchanged, indicating the bottleneck is elsewhere (WAL/terminal).
If coarsest granularity increases false-positive serialization conflicts, server_retry_ratio rises from 0.0.

why_exceeds_incumbent: Incumbent leaves predicate-lock promotion at defaults while max_pred_locks_per_transaction is 8192; the 0-bound is the untested opposite extreme of the granularity axis after r005's refuted increase, directly targeting the dominant GetUserTweets path's lock bookkeeping.

nodes.label: Coarsest SIRead granularity minimizes per-txn predicate-lock bookkeeping

cross_domain_requirements: WAL commit-path bundle (commit_delay/commit_siblings/wal_writer_flush_after) remains a competing mechanism for the wal_wait anomaly; not executed here.
